quests.title: A Wish For Smooth Sailing

dialogue.t: Alright then! Now that you're the proud owner of this commemorative map, you can draw as many different flavored mustaches on it as you like.
Hehe, sounds like a pretty tasty map. We'll look after it well!
Great! Your satisfaction is our number one priority.
Everything's all in order — now it's time to relax. Forget about work, and just enjoy the park!
Now that things have reached this point, we should add—
A pinch of salt?
A dash of pepper, actually.
Ah, brilliant!
Huh?
You two aren't talking about a new dessert menu by any chance, are you?

dialogue.sit: Pepper sounds a bit out of place in a dessert.

dialogue.t: Not desserts.
We're talking about the script!
My dear partner, photographer, rookie director... Our creativity must keep up with the overflowing enthusiasm of our fans!
There's no room for dull scripts on my stage! Plot twists should strike the audience like a cloud of pepper, leaving them sneezing in surprise. ACHOO!
The same logic applies in catering.
I once heard Miss Emilie mention that pepper could be used in perfumes. Perhaps I could find a way to make it work in desserts too...
Hmm... A peppery kick to complement the delicate sweetness of cream, perhaps...?
Wow, the two of them seem to be working together so well...
Paimon's struggling to imagine what a pepper cake would taste like, though!
Well, well, what do we have here? Escoffier's making a new cake?

dialogue.sit: Yes, and she's peppering in some new ideas.

dialogue.t: How exciting! When it's ready, do let me know — I'd love to try it!
Is it just Paimon, or does it seem like everyone's even more enthusiastic now that they've finished their work?
Why shouldn't they be? When your hard work pays off... that's when you should celebrate!
It's like a batch of fresh macarons — you should never let fear of sweetness stop you from adding all the filling you please.
After all, if there's ever a time to pile on the sugar, it's when you're making macarons!
Pile on the sugar!
Pile on the sugar!
...And, why are we piling on the sugar?
Lepine-Pauline, you're here! Is it ready?
Of course! It all went according to plan!
Huh? Were you off on some kind of important task?
I was indeed! Please, accept this!
Oh wow! It's a panoramic view of the amusement park, with everyone's illustrations on it!
Hehe, since the Film Fantasyland has been such a success, we decided to create a unique souvenir to remember it by.
We built this park together, brick by brick. So we decided we'd all contribute to drawing this map together, too.
To be fair, it was mostly thanks to Miss Lepine-Pauline — she's our expert when it comes to drawing, after all. But we all did our best to leave our own marks too.
That's right!
And on top of that, {NICKNAME}, I'm offering you a most special privilege.
You get to add a mustache to my portrait!
Cream-flavored, huh? Very traditional, but also... very delicious! Mm-hmm, you have my approval.
Alright then! Now that you're the proud owner of this commemorative map, you can draw as many different flavored mustaches on it as you like.
Hehe, sounds like a pretty tasty map. We'll look after it well!
Great! Your satisfaction is our number one priority.
Everything's all in order — now it's time to relax. Forget about work, and just enjoy the park!
Bolognese sauce flavor...? Well, that sure counts as a surprise twist! You win this round!
Alright then! Now that you're the proud owner of this commemorative map, you can draw as many different flavored mustaches on it as you like.
Hehe, sounds like a pretty tasty map. We'll look after it well!
Great! Your satisfaction is our number one priority.
Everything's all in order — now it's time to relax. Forget about work, and just enjoy the park!

quests.description: Thanks to everyone’s hard work, the Film Fantasyland is now in full swing. You finally have some free time to chat with your companions…
